ThingDef.label: Passive reinforced armor plating
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass module. Improves protection against sharp, blunt, and heat damage by 20 percentage points. Reduces the wearer's movement speed by 0.1. Requires no power.

ThingDef.label: Passive ballistic armor plates
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass module. Adds 15 percentage points to sharp armor. The added weight reduces the wearer's movement speed by 0.1. Requires no power.

ThingDef.label: Passive impact-dampening liner
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass module. Adds 20 percentage points to blunt armor. Its added mass reduces the wearer's movement speed by 0.1. Requires no power.

ThingDef.label: Passive thermal shielding inserts
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass or helmet module. Adds 25 percentage points to heat armor. Requires no power.

ThingDef.label: Passive cold-weather insulation
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass or helmet module. Increases cold insulation by 15 degrees. Requires no power.

ThingDef.label: Passive heat-dissipation liner
ThingDef.description: Passive cuirass or helmet module. Increases heat insulation by 10 degrees. Requires no power.
